page_note: 整页是一张幻灯片式图表：S&P 500 1980–2024 年年度总回报柱状图叠加年内最大回撤黑点标记，并附平均值文本框与来源注释。

heading.title: S&P 500 Annual Total Return and Max Drawdown

figures.source_line: Source: Cetera Investment Management, FactSet, YCharts. The annual total return includes dividends. The annual max decline is the largest price decline in each calendar year. Return and max drawdown data based on closing prices. Data as of 12/31/2024.

components.evidence: teal bars for Annual Total Return with black circular markers for Annual Max Drawdown in same panel
bars fall below the 0.0% line (-4.9%, -37.0%) and all drawdown dots sit below zero
boxed note inside plot: "1980 - 2024 Average Annual Total Return: 13.5% Average Annual Max Drawdown: -14.1%"
"Annual Total Return" and "Annual Max Drawdown" legend row beneath the x axis
bar percentages printed above bar tops; dot values in blue boxes on leader lines below dots
small italic "Source: Cetera Investment Management, FactSet, YCharts..." under the plot
45 bars plus 45 dots plus 90 printed value labels crowd the panel
a horizontal rule drawn at 0.0% separating positive bars from drawdown dots

new_components.name: leader_line_boxed_labels
new_components.evidence: each black dot's value sits in a blue filled box connected by a thin white leader line
new_components.why_it_matters: 数值不在标记处，需沿引线把蓝色标签框与对应黑点配对，错配会把回撤值归到相邻年份。

new_components.name: label_only_series_position
new_components.evidence: black dots for drawdown are drawn against the same % axis but many labels displaced far from dot
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时若以标签垂直位置对轴读取会严重偏差，必须以黑点位置为准或直接采用印刷数字。

difficulty_notes: 数值本身全部印在图上（45 个柱标 + 45 个回撤标签），读数不成问题；轴刻度 10 个百分点一格也无需目测。真正的障碍是定位：x 轴只标 1980/1985/.../2020，中间 4 个年份没有刻度，表格要为每个值给出「年份 + 系列名（Annual Total Return / Annual Max Drawdown）」两个键，而 31.7% 在 1985 与 1989 重复出现，仅凭系列名无法区分，必须依赖被隐藏的年份键；同时蓝框标签靠引线连到黑点，解析器易把标签配到相邻年份列。
